The structure of composition Al12Si3 (reduced formula Al4Si) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with 15 atoms in the unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Al and Si centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors; Al centers have 9 Al and 3 Si neighbors (2.94–3.08 Å), while Si centers have 12 Al neighbors (3.04–3.14 Å). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 15 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Al and Si coordination polyhedra.
